content: David Ramá-yargi-Naiot-neggweburgi wakitegusad, geb Jonatán-maidse nade gusad. David weyob Jonatánʼse egichialid: —¿Ar ibu an imaksa? ¿Ar ibu ibmar-isgana an imaksa? Emide, be-bab an-oburgwebied.
Jonatán, Davidʼga sogded: —¡Be bipisaar burgosuli! Ar an-bab bipisaale gwen angi ibmar-soggwenad odukudisulid, bela ibmar anga sogdaed. ¿Ibiga angi ibmar odukudagosunna? Geg angi odukued.

David ise-sogar sogdebalid: —Ar be-bab nue-wisid, bede nue-an-sabe. Degisoggu, be-bab na binsasargebed: ‘Jonatánʼga an we-ibmar mer-sogoye, adi, mer isdar-itogegarye.’ Ar Bab-Jehová-Dula-Maid-nuggi, degi, be-nuggi, an ise-sogar-soged, ar andi burgwednaga gudiid.
Jonatán, David-abin weyob sogded: —Degite, ibu bega sabi be an-abesunna, be anga sogdo, an bega saodo.
David ega sogded: —Be wisi, banedse nii-binid-yoleged-ibad. Degisoggu, reyba an mas gunned nikanad. Ar ibabo sapurba-dukuega be an-imake.

Ar be-bab an-amialile, ega be sogoed, David Belénʼse e-barmidega angi alamaknaigusye. Bela e-gwenadgande agi bukwamaladdeeye, degine, bela agine na birga-irba ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukdamarye anga sogye, ega be sogoed.
Ar bega sokardibe, nueganbiye, adi, an dobguosulid. Ar ulualirdi, be wisdo, an-oburgwedgi binsae.
Ar Bab-Jehová-asabin be anbo-igar-mesissoggu, an bega sogsundo, mer be an-yardako. Ar begi nosa be an-dakele, be-babga mer be an-urmako. ¡Be-sunnad bur be an-oburgo! A bur nabirid.
Jonatán, Davidʼga sogded: —¡Mer deyob be binsae! Ar an-bab be-oakalobiye an wisgualile, ¿an sunna bega sogsasulir be insae? An bega sogsale.
David, Jonatánʼga sogded: —Be-babde be-abin sokalile, ede an-oburgoye, degite, ¿doa an-owisogoe?
David bela ega ibmar-sogsagu, Jonatán sapurba Davidʼbo nadsunnad. Agine,
Jonatán, Davidʼga sogded: —Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-nuggi ise-sogar an bega soged, wegi-wachi achuledse an-bab-e-binsaed an wisguoed. Ar begi nueganbi sunmakele, an be-owisogoed.
Ar an-bab be-oakalobiye sogele, an be-owisogoed, adi, be wakinnegar. An be-owisosulile, Bab-Jehová sabsur-an-odurdakodo. ¡Ar Bab-Jehová igi an-babba gudigusa, deyobi beba gudigumogoed!
An bese wis ibmar egised, ar amba an dula-gudiidgi Bab-Jehová begi nued-binsadele, be angi nued-binsamogo, mer an-oburgwemalaga be imako.
Bab-Jehová we-napneggi bela bega be-isdarmalad-obelosale, melle an-gwenadgandi be obelogo, be anga wile dako.
¡Bab-Jehová bela be-isdarmalad-sabsur-odurdakega imaksun! Weyobi, Jonatán, Davidʼbo na igar mesisad.
Ar ade, Jonatán na eyobi David-sabed. Jonatán nue-David-sabsoggu, a-ulale, Jonatán Davidʼbo weyobi ise-sogar igar-mesisbalid.
Davidʼga sogded: —Banedse nii-binid-yolegoed-ibad. Ar be-gan ollosii dakarmalale, be-obardamaloed.
Iduar na be bia dukusgusa, asega be achur naoed, Ezel-akwa-dikarba be sigoed.
Akwasik sigu-minaiyob yamo an saoed. Geb asiki, sigu warbaa an mioed.
Geb sigu-sunaega, an-mai-wargwen an barmidoed. An ega sogdibe: ‘Be dake, sigumar wesik meremamaid be sunae’, dobsuli sunna be nodaged. ¡Bab-Jehová-Dula-Maid-nuggi an bega soged!
Ar ega an sogerdi: ‘Be dake, sigumar bur egesik mamaid’, adi, Bab-Jehová naed be-abeged. ¡Degisoggu, be wakinsunnoed!
¡Anmar na ise-sogar-ibmar-sogsamaladi, Bab-Jehová degisadegu dulemar-baiganga-sogega guoed!
Degisoggu, David sapurba dukussunnad. Nii-binid-yoleged-iba-onodedgi, rey igi na gusgu galu-naga mas-gunnega sigdae,
deyobi mesegi galu-naga sigisad. Jonatán rey-asabin sigisad, Abnerʼdi Saúl-dikarba sigismogad. David-e-gandi ollobi-sigisad.
A-ibagi, Saúl akar-sogsasulid, ar ade, binsaed: “David igi-gusdibeye na binsaed, san-swilidik-gudisulirgeberye binsaed.”
Banedgine, Saúl, David-e-gan amba ollobi-sii dakarbalid. Geb Saúl e-machi-Jonatánʼga sokalid: —¿Ibiga Isaí-machi, masgunnega sae nonisuli? Emi amba nonisurbalid. ¿Ibigala?
Jonatán e-babga sogded: —David Belénʼse e-barmidega angi alamaknai gusad.

Anga sogsad: ‘Wis be an-barmidye. An-gwenadgande na birga-irba ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukdamarye. Ede a-daknabiye, anga sogsad. Degine, an-gwenad anbina gochaye, anmarse dagoye. Degisoggu, wis be an-barmidye, an-gwenadgan-daknaegarye,’ anga sogsad. A-ulale, David be-abargi mas-gunnega daklesulid.
Saúl deyob Jonatán ega-soge itoargua, Jonatánʼse uluded. Ega sogded: —¡Bedi ome-gambanuchu-imaked-e-mimmid! ¿David-be-ai-nuedid an wissurye be angi binsae? ¡Be-nanga, degi, bega binged-dummad gued!
We-napneggi Isaí-machi dula-gudiidgi, be, degi, be-yar-seoedi bonisuli-guosulid, boni-nika guedsegad. ¡David-aminamalagala, sordamar be barmide! Geb wese be anga sedamalo, ar oburgwilegergebed.
Jonatán e-bab-abin sogded: —¿Ar ibiga David-oburgwilegoe? ¿Ibu ibmar-isgana imaksasunna?
Agine, Saúl, Jonatán-onailiksaega eswar-suid egi mechalid. Degidbali, Jonatán magar-daknonikid, ar e-babde David-oburgwedgi binsae.
Jonatán uludedba mese-naba-siidgi gwichibin-imaksad, geb iba-onolenaid-ibbogwadgi bar mas-guchasulid. Ar e-bab Davidʼgi sabsur-ulussoggu, Jonatánʼdi nue bukib-itossunnad.
Banedgi wakudaryalaba, Jonatán, David-abinguega sapurba naded. E-mai-sapingwagwad eba nade gusmogad.
Jonatán e-maiga sogded: “Sigumar-an-mioed be sunao.” E-mai abarmakded, geb Jonatánʼdi egi dikasur sigu metedaed.
Ar mai na bia sigu argwachadse mosgua, Jonatán binnasur ese goted: “¡Be-biriba! ¡Be-biriba sigu mellemai!
¡Gwae be abarmakde! ¡Mer be gwisgue!” Jonatán deyobi ese gorgwichi gusad. Ar mai sigu-susgua, e-dummadga senonikid.
Maidi gwen akar binsasulid, ar ade, Jonatán Davidʼbo unnila wismalad, ar sigu-miedde ibi-obare.
Geb degine, Jonatán na e-maiga bila-onogedgi-ibmar-ebumalad uksad. Ega sogded: —Be nae. Be gannar negse we-ibmar sede.

Ar mai na nadgua, David, e-duku-siidgi noalid. Geb David, Jonatán-asabin ilapaa dulluu e-bebe napase-ebulegedse imaksad. A-sorbali, angaagwar na gasmalad, degine, ebobela na bosmarbalid. Ar Davidʼdi bur bule bosad.

Jonatán, Davidʼga sogded: “Gwage-bogidikidgi be nae, ar ade, Bab-Jehová-nuggi anmar weyob ise-sogar imaksad, Bab-Jehová anmarba, degi, anmar-waganba degisadegu gudii guoye.” Degisoggu, David nadsunnad. Geb Jonatánʼdi neggweburse gannar nonikid.
